answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 36520 Country: Pakistan Title: In last rakah imam forgot to sit for tashahhud and stood up. He completed the rakah with sajdah sahv. Is it correct Question: (1) In last rakah imam forgot to sit for tashahhud and stood up. He completed the rakah with sajdah sahv. Is it correct? (2) I join the jamah when was in sajdah. After takbir should I stand for Qayam for few seconds or should I go to sajdah directly after takbir? (3) Can I recite the Quran (without touching and reading, only memorized Quran) when ghusl is fardh on me? Answer ID: 36520 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 221/127/H=1433) (1) It was not right rather it is necessary to repeat the salah. (2) Say takbir tahrima comfortably and then go to sajdah directly. (3) It is not lawful for a junubi person to recite the holy Quran even verbally. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
